title: Thu 19 Nov · evening check
summary:
[b]Today:[/b] US claims 203k (vs 197k) and Philly Fed 6.3 (vs 20.1) but prices paid 58.2; Wall Street sold off and the VIX hit 27–28 intraday (franc trigger met, close pending); RBA hikes fully priced out (June cut 68%); Carney–Trump: no US deal.
[b]Next (Bucharest):[/b] Japan CPI 01:30, UK retail sales 09:00, Lagarde 10:30, Canada retail sales 15:30, US Michigan 17:00; Friday closes set the W48 risk regime.

USD.note: Second-tier data mixed (claims 203k, Philly 6.3) but prices paid jumped to 58.2; hike path intact.

EUR.note: No new spread print after 156.3bp (17 Nov); Senate budget debate from Friday.

GBP.note: Bailey balanced (no pre-set path); 2027 BoE pricing trimmed to ~80bp.

JPY.note: Katayama repeats the warning; December BoJ hike expected; CPI tonight.

CHF.note: VIX 27–28 intraday meets the franc condition (two consistent sources); close pending; score re-measured Friday.

CAD.note: Carney after meeting Trump: deal possible but not yet there; oil lower.

AUD.note: Swaps price no RBA hike and a 68% cut by June; shadow +3 central, 0 if R2 is cut.

NZD.note: RBNZ 25bp hike priced at 78%; no score change.

XAU.note: Gold factor −3 unchanged; XAU shadow +3 only via the USD shadow.
